name: dropthehassle
description: Your AI puts the site it built live on a real link with HTTPS, not localhost: a free link with no account or token for the first publish. Want your own .com? It hands you a €19/$19 payment link; after you pay, the site goes live on it with no DNS. Your AI can also tell you a claimed site's visitors, leads and status. No tool spends money.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. No account or token needed for the first publish.

npm.description: Run locally via stdio (talks to the hosted service)

examples.title: Publish a site
examples.description: Make a built site live on a free HTTPS link
examples.prompt: Publish this folder and give me the live link.

examples.title: Find a .com
examples.description: Check names and get a payment link for the human
examples.prompt: Find a free .com for this site and give me the payment link.

examples.title: Site status
examples.prompt: How many visitors did my site get this week, and are there new leads?
